title: 修復自訂動作選單造成程式退出
summary: 修正自訂動作選單分隔線的樣式衝突，讓右鍵與更多操作選單正常開啟。
highlights: 自訂動作的右鍵與「⋯」選單可正常顯示全部指令，不再因分隔線樣式錯誤退出程式。
usage: 重新啟動更新後的 SnapBar，開啟動作列設定，在自訂動作上按右鍵或點選「⋯」即可使用；無需額外設定。

en.title: Fix a crash when opening custom action menus
en.summary: Resolve a separator style conflict so custom action context menus and options menus open correctly.
highlights: Custom action right-click and options menus display all commands without crashing because of a separator style mismatch.
en.usage: Restart the updated SnapBar, open action bar settings, then right-click a custom action or click its options button. No additional setup is required.
